CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "default"."otel_traces"  (
    Timestamp DateTime64(9) CODEC(Delta, ZSTD({p1:Int64})),
    TraceId String CODEC(ZSTD({p2:Int64})),
    SpanId String CODEC(ZSTD({p3:Int64})),
    ParentSpanId String CODEC(ZSTD({p4:Int64})),
    TraceState String CODEC(ZSTD({p5:Int64})),
    SpanName LowCardinality(String) CODEC(ZSTD({p6:Int64})),
    SpanKind LowCardinality(String) CODEC(ZSTD({p7:Int64})),
    ServiceName LowCardinality(String) CODEC(ZSTD({p8:Int64})),
    ResourceAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String) CODEC(ZSTD({p9:Int64})),
    ScopeName String CODEC(ZSTD({p10:Int64})),
    ScopeVersion String CODEC(ZSTD({p11:Int64})),
    SpanAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String) CODEC(ZSTD({p12:Int64})),
    Duration UInt64 CODEC(ZSTD({p13:Int64})),
    StatusCode LowCardinality(String) CODEC(ZSTD({p14:Int64})),
    StatusMessage String CODEC(ZSTD({p15:Int64})),
    Events Nested (
        Timestamp DateTime64(9),
        Name LowCardinality(String),
        Attributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String)
    ) CODEC(ZSTD({p16:Int64})),
    Links Nested (
        TraceId String,
        SpanId String,
        TraceState String,
        Attributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String)
    ) CODEC(ZSTD({p17:Int64})),
    INDEX idx_trace_id TraceId TYPE bloom_filter({p18:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p19:Int64},
    INDEX idx_res_attr_key mapKeys(ResourceAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p20:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p21:Int64},
    INDEX idx_res_attr_value mapValues(ResourceAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p22:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p23:Int64},
    INDEX idx_span_attr_key mapKeys(SpanAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p24:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p25:Int64},
    INDEX idx_span_attr_value mapValues(SpanAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p26:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p27:Int64},
    INDEX idx_duration Duration TYPE minmax GRANULARITY {p28:Int64}
) ENGINE = MergeTree()
PARTITION BY toDate(Timestamp)
ORDER BY (ServiceName, SpanName, toDateTime(Timestamp))
TTL toDateTime(Timestamp) + toIntervalDay({p29:Int64})
SETTINGS index_granularity={p30:Int64}, ttl_only_drop_parts = {p31:Int64}

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW IF NOT EXISTS "default"."otel_traces_trace_id_ts_mv" 
TO "default"."otel_traces_trace_id_ts"
AS SELECT
              TraceId,
              min(Timestamp) as Start,
              max(Timestamp) as End
   FROM "default"."otel_traces"

   GROUP BY TraceId

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "default"."otel_metrics_histogram"  (
                                     ResourceAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String) CODEC(ZSTD({p1:Int64})),
    ResourceSchemaUrl String CODEC(ZSTD({p2:Int64})),
    ScopeName String CODEC(ZSTD({p3:Int64})),
    ScopeVersion String CODEC(ZSTD({p4:Int64})),
    ScopeAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String) CODEC(ZSTD({p5:Int64})),
    ScopeDroppedAttrCount UInt32 CODEC(ZSTD({p6:Int64})),
    ScopeSchemaUrl String CODEC(ZSTD({p7:Int64})),
    ServiceName LowCardinality(String) CODEC(ZSTD({p8:Int64})),
    MetricName String CODEC(ZSTD({p9:Int64})),
    MetricDescription String CODEC(ZSTD({p10:Int64})),
    MetricUnit String CODEC(ZSTD({p11:Int64})),
    Attributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String) CODEC(ZSTD({p12:Int64})),
    StartTimeUnix DateTime64(9) CODEC(Delta, ZSTD({p13:Int64})),
    TimeUnix DateTime64(9) CODEC(Delta, ZSTD({p14:Int64})),
    Count UInt64 CODEC(Delta, ZSTD({p15:Int64})),
    Sum Float64 CODEC(ZSTD({p16:Int64})),
    BucketCounts Array(UInt64) CODEC(ZSTD({p17:Int64})),
    ExplicitBounds Array(Float64) CODEC(ZSTD({p18:Int64})),
    Exemplars Nested (
                         FilteredAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String),
    TimeUnix DateTime64(9),
    Value Float64,
    SpanId String,
    TraceId String
    ) CODEC(ZSTD({p19:Int64})),
    Flags UInt32 CODEC(ZSTD({p20:Int64})),
    Min Float64 CODEC(ZSTD({p21:Int64})),
    Max Float64 CODEC(ZSTD({p22:Int64})),
    AggregationTemporality Int32 CODEC(ZSTD({p23:Int64})),
    INDEX idx_res_attr_key mapKeys(ResourceAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p24:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p25:Int64},
    INDEX idx_res_attr_value mapValues(ResourceAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p26:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p27:Int64},
    INDEX idx_scope_attr_key mapKeys(ScopeAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p28:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p29:Int64},
    INDEX idx_scope_attr_value mapValues(ScopeAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p30:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p31:Int64},
    INDEX idx_attr_key mapKeys(Attributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p32:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p33:Int64},
    INDEX idx_attr_value mapValues(Attributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p34:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p35:Int64}
    ) ENGINE = MergeTree()
    TTL toDateTime(TimeUnix) + toIntervalDay({p36:Int64})

    SETTINGS index_granularity={p37:Int64}, ttl_only_drop_parts = {p38:Int64}
